issues.text: Round-1 issues are all resolved. New in round 2: the expected result names a second test project, `DonHang.Samples.Tests`, that the lesson never mentions. Section 4 says `dotnet test` runs every .NET test, so I can accept it, but I paused to wonder whether those 13 tests are part of the gate in CI too, since only the 24 are said to match CI.
